history.reason: 先补齐验证，在本地运行完整的 sidebar Pester 测试套件，确认 watcher 134 项全过；统一 Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff 的严格判断逻辑；勾选 AC8 并更新 implement.md。确认无误后再进入 Trellis Phase 3.3/3.4 流程。

findings.failure_scenario: implement.md line 43 records the full sidebar run as watcher 123/123, while line 39 records the final focused run as 134/134. The roughly eleven regressions added after the Grok and Claude reviews (artifact-only contradiction cases, non-boolean submissionAttempted, noncanonical schema variants) were therefore never exercised together with the adapter suite in one run. If one of those late additions interacts badly with adapter-suite shared state or mock leakage, the failure would only surface on the next full run, after commit.
findings.short_summary: Full sidebar Pester evidence is stale vs final code
findings.summary: AC8 is unchecked and the recorded full-sidebar Pester run predates the final review-driven test additions, so no full-suite result exists at the reviewed revision.

findings.failure_scenario: prd.md line 53 leaves AC8 (PowerShell parse, focused Pester, full sidebar Pester, harness conflicts/doctor/verify, offline gates, unrelated-diff check) unchecked while AC1 through AC7 are checked. If the task is committed and archived from this state, the completion record would assert delivery against a criterion no artifact marks as met, and a later regression triage would have no full-suite baseline at the delivered revision to compare against.
findings.short_summary: AC8 unchecked at the final PM gate
findings.summary: The task reached FINAL_REVIEW with acceptance criterion AC8 still unchecked in the PRD, so the plan's own validation gate is formally open.

findings.failure_scenario: evidence_refs and task.json relatedFiles both point at .agents/skills/chatgpt-pro-sidebar/scripts/chatgpt-pro-sidebar-watch.ps1 and its test file, but snapshots/d4347237-e6d4-43b5-88dd-23578b5d4999/root contains only .harness, .trellis, components, docs, LICENSES, scripts and tests. A reviewer restricted to the snapshot would have to accept the entire state-machine change on documentation alone; I fell back to the live worktree, which means my review is of current working-tree state rather than of the digest-pinned snapshot.
findings.short_summary: PM snapshot omits the .agents changed files
findings.summary: The supplied PM snapshot does not contain the .agents directory, so the two primary changed files named in evidence_refs and relatedFiles were not reviewable from the snapshot itself.

findings.failure_scenario: A claim file whose schemaVersion is the JSON string "2" or a decimal 2.0 satisfies [int](Get-WatchProperty $claim 'schemaVersion' 0) -ne $Script:CapacityClaimSchemaVersion at line 2313 and passes handoff validation, whereas Test-CapacityClaimSchemaVersion at line 1965 would reject it. The round still fails closed at Confirm-CapacitySubmissionAttempt line 2149 before any adapter call, so there is no exact-once exposure today, but the two validation predicates diverging invites a future change that moves the boundary check without noticing the weaker gate.
findings.short_summary: Handoff uses coercive int cast for schemaVersion
findings.summary: Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff validates the claim schema with a coercive [int] cast rather than the strict Test-CapacityClaimSchemaVersion predicate used everywhere else.

findings.failure_scenario: An old parent that writes run-starting/submissionAttempted=true and a new child that requires schema 2 with submissionAttempted=false, or the reverse, will fail handoff validation. implement.md line 63 and design.md line 78 capture this as a manual 'wait for in-flight batches to drain' instruction with no code-level version negotiation or operator-facing warning, so a rollout or rollback during an active batch silently converts running rounds into ConcurrencySlotRecoveryRequired isolations that then need manual slot recovery.
findings.short_summary: Batch version-skew guard is a manual unchecked step
findings.summary: The parent/child handoff protocol change is not backward compatible across process versions, and the only mitigation is an unchecked manual pre-deployment check.

processAdjustments.adjustment: Make the snapshot builder include every path listed in evidence_refs and relatedFiles, and fail snapshot creation if any referenced path is missing, so a PM gate can never silently degrade to documentation-only review of the main change surface.
processAdjustments.observation: The PM snapshot at snapshots/d4347237-e6d4-43b5-88dd-23578b5d4999/root excluded the .agents directory even though both primary changed files live there and are named in evidence_refs and task.json relatedFiles. .trellis and .harness were included, so the exclusion is selective rather than a blanket dot-directory filter.

processAdjustments.adjustment: Provision Pester and git in the PM review environment, or attach machine-readable test output (Pester NUnit or JSON results) and a git diff --stat artifact to the evidence bundle, so the gate can confirm rather than restate the implementer's numbers.
processAdjustments.observation: The review environment has neither Pester nor git on PATH, so no test suite could be re-executed and no diff could be inspected. Every quantitative claim in this review about test counts and diff cleanliness is therefore relayed rather than verified.

processAdjustments.adjustment: Require that a FINAL_REVIEW request either has all acceptance criteria checked or names each open criterion explicitly in the request payload, and require that recorded test counts carry the revision or timestamp they were produced at so staleness is visible without cross-referencing.
processAdjustments.observation: The task advanced to FINAL_REVIEW with AC8 unchecked and with an implement.md note recording full-suite results (watcher 123/123) that a later plan line contradicts (focused 134/134), leaving the reader to infer that the full run is stale.

processAdjustments.adjustment: When a review finds a coercion defect, sweep every sibling call site for the same pattern in the same change rather than fixing only the reported instance, and prefer a single named predicate function over inline casts for any value that gates an exact-once boundary.
processAdjustments.observation: Three separate places validate the capacity claim schema, and two use the strict canonical predicate while the handoff path uses a coercive cast. The coercive-cast class of defect was already found once during this task, by GPT Pro in round 2.

latestAdvice.productManagerStatement:
你要修的问题已经修好了，而且修的方式是对的：不是放松判断，而是把状态语义改准。

原来 `submissionAttempted=true` 在真正调用 adapter 之前就被写了（批处理在 `Start-BatchRoundProcess` 之前，直接 run-root 在 `Invoke-RootWaitRound` 之前），所以进程在这个窗口里退出时，恢复逻辑没法区分「从来没发」和「可能已经发了」，只能保守隔离，槽就永久占着。

现在的做法：容量 claim 自己升到 schema 2（watcher/evidence 和 batch manifest 仍然是 1，我确认过）。直接路径和批处理父进程在启动阶段只写 `run-starting/submissionAttempted=false`；唯一的 `false -> true` 转换放在 `Invoke-RootWaitRound` 里，就在唯一那次 `Invoke-WatchAdapterSend` 的前一行，带 mutex、按 claimId 做 compare-and-swap，同时写入时间戳。转换失败就在调用 adapter 之前抛 `ConcurrencySlotRecoveryRequired`，不会有任何发送。

回收方面新增的 `never-invoked` 分支很窄：必须是 schema 2、phase 精确为 `run-starting`、`submissionAttempted` 是真正的布尔 false、没有 `submissionAttemptedAtUtc`/`watcherId`/`terminalStatus`、证据目录里一个持久文件都没有，而且这个分支排在所有既有 durable 证明之后。你原来要求保留的保守边界完全没动：`run-starting/true`、旧 schema、身份不匹配、矛盾证据，全部继续隔离并保留 claim。恢复路径不碰 adapter、不开浏览器、不删 idempotency/target claim、不授权重发。3/6/7200 也没变，`slots` 现在多输出 schema 和提交时间字段方便审计。

AC1 到 AC7 我都在代码里逐条核对过，测试也确实覆盖到了顺序断言和零调用断言。

还差一件事：AC8 没打勾。完整 sidebar 测试的记录是 watcher 123/123，但最后一轮评审又加了约十一个用例、聚焦跑是 134/134，也就是说当前这版代码还没跑过一次完整套件。这个环境里没有 Pester 和 git，我没法替你重跑，只独立确认了两个 PowerShell 文件解析零错误。所以建议：提交前把两个 sidebar 测试文件一起跑一遍，确认 watcher 是 134、adapter 只剩那个在 main 上也失败的老问题，然后再勾 AC8、更新 implement.md 里那条过时的 123/123 记录。

另外两个小事，不拦提交：`Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff` 里 schemaVersion 用的是 `[int]` 强制转换，和别处的严格判定不一致（下游 CAS 仍会 fail closed，所以目前没有 exact-once 风险，但建议统一）；还有部署/回滚前确认没有 in-flight batch 这一条目前只是人工步骤，代码不会检测新旧 parent/child 版本交错。

产品范围我判定为通过，剩下的是把 AC8 的验证补上再提交。
latestAdvice.recommendedNextAction: Before Trellis Phase 3.3/3.4, close AC8 at the current revision: run both sidebar Pester files in a single invocation and confirm the watcher file reports 134 passing while the adapter file shows only the known pre-existing 'uses full profile tree when tab-list URL is abbreviated' failure; capture that the same adapter failure reproduces on origin/main; and run git status --short plus git diff --stat to confirm the diff is limited to chatgpt-pro-sidebar-watch.ps1, chatgpt-pro-sidebar-watch.Tests.ps1, chatgpt-pro-agent-browser-v2.md and the task directory. Then check AC8 in prd.md and the full-sidebar item at implement.md line 40, replacing the stale 123/123 note with the final counts. After that, proceed with the spec-update judgment and the commit; do not archive until the in-flight-batch precondition at implement.md line 63 is confirmed. The low-severity coercive [int] schema cast at chatgpt-pro-sidebar-watch.ps1:2313 should be aligned with Test-CapacityClaimSchemaVersion, but it is defence-in-depth only and need not block the commit.

risks.description: No full sidebar Pester run exists at the final revision. The recorded full run covered 123 watcher tests; the focused suite is now 134. Late-added contradiction and malformed-input regressions have never run alongside the adapter suite in the same session, where shared mock or fixture state is most likely to interact.
risks.mitigation: Re-run both sidebar test files in one invocation at the current revision, confirm the watcher file reports 134 passing, confirm the adapter file still reports exactly the one known baseline failure, then check AC8 in prd.md and the corresponding implement.md Phase 3 item.

risks.description: Batch parent/child version skew. The handoff contract changed from run-starting/true to schema-2 run-starting/false, and validation is fail-closed on both sides, so any mixed-version parent/child pair converts an in-flight round into a retained, manually recoverable slot rather than degrading gracefully.
risks.mitigation: Confirm no in-flight batch before deploying or rolling back, as design.md line 78 and implement.md line 63 require. Consider promoting that manual step into an explicit operator-facing precondition in the runbook, since nothing in the code detects or warns about skew.

risks.description: Divergent schema-validation strictness. Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff uses a coercive [int] cast at line 2313 while the release proof and the submission compare-and-swap use the strict canonical-integer predicate at line 1965. Today the strict gate downstream still fails closed before the adapter, so exact-once is preserved, but the inconsistency is a latent trap if the boundary check is ever relocated or relaxed.
risks.mitigation: Replace the coercive cast in Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff with Test-CapacityClaimSchemaVersion so a single predicate governs every schema decision, and add a handoff test case seeding schemaVersion as the string "2".

risks.description: Review provenance gap. The PM snapshot excluded .agents, so the digest-pinned artifact does not contain the two files carrying nearly all of the behavioural change; this review verified them against mutable working-tree state instead.
risks.mitigation: Fix the snapshot filter so dot-directories referenced in evidence_refs and task.json relatedFiles are included, and re-snapshot before archiving so the accepted state is reproducible from the digest alone.

risks.description: Historical schema-1 run-starting/true claims that may already occupy real capacity slots are explicitly out of scope and are not auto-released, so an operator may still see permanently held slots from before this change and mistake them for the bug being fixed.
risks.mitigation: Confirmed as intended per prd.md Out of scope. Worth a one-line operator note that pre-existing ambiguous claims still require manual recovery and that the fix applies only to claims created after deployment.
